english.title: Exporter of dutiable goods where entry cancelled fail to warehouse / move them to a specified place
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an exporter where an entry in respect of

(A)_[dutiable]_
(B)_[restricted]_

goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..), was treated as cancelled by virtue of section 56 of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979, the goods not having been forfeited under section 56(2)(b) of that Act, failed to

english.legislation: Contrary to section 56(3)(c) and (5) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
